rationale: SSL has gapped up 5.44% on 4.31x relative volume with no news catalyst, and price is sitting at 97.1% of today's range just $0.02 below the session high — a position that offers poor risk/reward for a long entry (chasing near the top) and uncertain short setup given the strong momentum and no clear reversal signal in the last five 1-minute candles. The broader market is weak (SPY -1.03%, VIXY +3.72%), which adds macro headwind to a long but the stock is ignoring it, suggesting idiosyncratic strength that makes a short equally risky. With no news to explain the move and no clean technical level to anchor a stop, the edge is insufficient to justify a new position.
